title: Grateful Dead Live at Iowa Fieldhouse - University of Iowa on 1982-08-10
lineage: DAT > WAV (via TB Fiji S/PDIF) > SHN
source: SBD > Master Cassette > DAT > Digidesign/Audio Media > DAT

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with minor sound problems captures a high‑energy 1982 show that still stands out thanks to a double encore and an unforgettable vibe.
ai_review.review: The reviewer describes the concert as mind‑blowing, noting a lively crowd that even cleared chairs to dance and enjoyed a rare double encore. Although the tape suffers from some sound issues, the soundboard source provides enough clarity to make this performance a cherished gem for fans.

ai_rating.rationale: One enthusiastic 4‑star review highlights a strong show with high energy and memorable moments, while acknowledging sound problems that keep the recording from being rated higher.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer mentions sound problems on the tape; overall mix is usable but not pristine.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert built momentum, culminating in a double encore that kept the audience dancing and energized throughout.
